steps: Tap the menu, then “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
In Notifications → Preferences, turn push on for this device.
android.title: Android (Chrome)

steps: Use the desktop app once it is released; until then, install the browser version.
In Chrome or Edge, open the install icon at the right of the address bar.
In Notifications → Preferences, turn push on for this device.
desktop.title: Windows and Mac

install.intro: GymOps runs in the browser, but installed it opens like an app, keeps you signed in and — on iPhone, only then — can send you push notifications.

steps: Open GymOps in Safari. Chrome on iPhone cannot install it.
Tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.
Open GymOps from the Home Screen icon, not from Safari.
In Notifications → Preferences, turn push on for this device.
ios.title: iPhone and iPad (Safari)

install.pushNote: Push is per device and per browser: turning it on here does not turn it on anywhere else, and signing out of a browser leaves its subscription behind until you turn it off.
